# danish: Hvad er klokken?
english: What time is it?

# danish: Klokken er halv otte.
english: It is half past seven.

# danish: Vi mødes kvart over tre.
english: We are meeting at a quarter past three.

# danish: Toget kører om ti minutter.
english: The train leaves in ten minutes.

# danish: Jeg kom hjem for en time siden.
english: I came home an hour ago.

# danish: I morgen er det tirsdag.
english: Tomorrow is Tuesday.

# danish: Min fødselsdag er den femte maj.
english: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

# danish: Om sommeren er dagene lange i Danmark.
english: In summer, the days are long in Denmark.

# danish: Det regner, så jeg tager en paraply med.
english: It is raining, so I am taking an umbrella.

# danish: Vejrudsigten lover sol i weekenden.
english: The weather forecast promises sunshine this weekend.

# danish: Det blæser meget ude ved kysten.
english: It is very windy out by the coast.

# danish: Der ligger sne på taget.
english: There is snow on the roof.

# danish: I nat falder temperaturen til under frysepunktet.
english: Tonight the temperature will fall below freezing.

# danish: Solen går ned bag træerne.
english: The sun is setting behind the trees.

# danish: Vi går en tur i skoven efter frokost.
english: We are going for a walk in the forest after lunch.

# danish: Der svømmer to svaner på søen.
english: Two swans are swimming on the lake.

# danish: Jeg så et rådyr på marken i morges.
english: I saw a roe deer in the field this morning.

# danish: Bøgen får lysegrønne blade om foråret.
english: The beech tree gets light green leaves in spring.

# danish: Lad os samle affaldet op og tage det med hjem.
english: Let us pick up the rubbish and take it home.

# danish: Det er rart at være ude i naturen.
english: It is nice to be out in nature.
